study: M8 AH team-discipline × referee-specific historical residual interaction; historical event-time research only

coverage.discipline_match_history_actual_source: M5 cached completed TotalCorner fixtures; 90/365-day team YC/RC features, UTC-date cutoff lag 3 days

methodology.Crown_contract: T1 Crown AH line and paired decimal prices; source-event time, not received-time executable quote
methodology.time_forward: for each test year 2024/2025/2026, train only 2019 through prior calendar year; all train/test FIDs share the common valid feature cohort; receipt-archive FIDs excluded from model training
methodology.discipline_features: The exact 14 pregame yellow/red rate main and team-side interaction features from R48; generated from prior completed M5 schedule matches only, at least 3 UTC calendar days before target; no target cards used.
methodology.referee_feature: Referee/competition centered historical Crown AH goal-difference residual over previous 365 Beijing dates, 3-day lag, shrink n/(n+5); target assignment from retrospective Transfermarkt games archive with no verified pregame announcement timestamp.
methodology.interaction: Two fixed products: 365-day team yellow-card home-away rate difference × referee centered/shrunk AH residual; 365-day team red-card rate difference × the same referee residual. No parameter sweep or target-year tuning.
methodology.estimators: Ridge alpha=100, standardization fitted within each expanding training fold, Gaussian integer-margin approximation using training RMSE; choose side with higher expected net AH return at actual Crown odds. No EV abstention threshold.
methodology.settlement: Quarter AH split into adjacent half-goal legs and average per-leg stake return.
